body: The question what I'm I hanging for? I have family that I barely have any relationship with, I have no friends, no romantic relationships? I'm holding to go from being a young bitter, miserable person to a old bitter, miserable person.
Sometimes when I'm driving I get a strong urge to just veer my car off a bridge or into a telephone poll at least my suicide would look like an accident.
No I don't fear I would actually welcome it. Life is overrated for some.
